method: Non-blind source-grounded self-review of frozen assertions. findings.evidence: The initial answer says isRowAffected is unavailable. KSimpleSaveResult.kt lines 7-8 define it as affectedRowCountMap.isNotEmpty(). The answer also suggests a Java-style getAffectedRowCount with Item::class.java for Kotlin, but KMutationResult declares affectedRowCount(KClass) and affectedRowCount(KProperty1).
findings.fix: Added a Java/Kotlin result-contract table and exact count-call examples to jimmer-save-modes, with a short cross-reference in jimmer-performance. Neither isModified nor Kotlin isRowAffected is an acceptance flag.

findings.evidence: NONE dissociation is treated as CHECK on the save detach path (DetachOptions), not as automatic FK nulling.
findings.fix: jimmer-save-modes requires an explicit SET_NULL/DELETE policy on the owning reference for save-time dissociation; reruns comply.
